title: The Parable of the Vineyard
notes: This chunk tightly decodes the vineyard symbols—wall as salvation, tower as the Name/sanctuary, winepress as the dual vintage of fruit or blood, Sent as Siloam and the apostolic verb, builders as the tenants—with dense cross-links and AD 70 fulfillment. The voice stays assertive, law-positive, and scripture-led. Residual defects are four imperative staging cues that command the reader and one clear typo (missing space). No quote wording, doctrine, or symbol claims need alteration; the chain is already clean and the structure holds. Surgical cue removals restore house style while preserving density and the author's register.

This chunk tightly assembles the wall, hedge, plumbline, flood, and living-stone cluster from Proverbs through Revelation into one continuous argument: the builders’ counterfeit structures fall to the same water while the rejected stone becomes the living house and the named wall of the city. Strengths include the clean two-direction demolition of the phragmos, the sagab/shataph root work, the side-by-side quarry texts in Peter, and the assertive hand-off to the next chapter. A few elliptical constructions slightly slow first reading, and the modern file/blueprint language sits beside the biblical images without fighting them. No staging, no sentence-open violations, no quote or doctrine problems. Density and law-positive voice hold throughout.

proposals.old: Walk the parable with its own vocabulary and it stops being a fable about ingratitude; it becomes an indictment with every party named, a sentence with a date on it, and the blueprint of the building that rose from the rubble.
proposals.new: The parable with its own vocabulary stops being a fable about ingratitude; it becomes an indictment with every party named, a sentence with a date on it, and the blueprint of the building that rose from the rubble.
proposals.summary: Removes imperative director cue 'Walk the parable'.
proposals.rationale: House style bars presenter commands that stage the reader; the claim asserts cleanly without the cue.

proposals.old: Read the vineyard's sentence with the definition installed and it turns exact: to break down the wall is to withdraw salvation, and what stood inside is trodden down.
proposals.new: The vineyard's sentence with the definition installed turns exact: to break down the wall is to withdraw salvation, and what stood inside is trodden down.
proposals.rationale: Matches forbidden staging patterns; the definition installs and the sentence turns exact without instructing the reader.

proposals.old: Redraw the parable's real estate with the labels on: the house of Israel, enclosed in salvation, the temple standing in the middle — let out to tenant farmers, with the owner away and the fruit coming due.
proposals.new: The parable's real estate with the labels on is the house of Israel, enclosed in salvation, the temple standing in the middle — let out to tenant farmers, with the owner away and the fruit coming due.
proposals.rationale: Asserts the labeled real estate directly; avoids commanding the reader to redraw.

proposals.old: Genesis dressed Judah in garments washed in the blood of grapes; the Treader wears the samewardrobe with the other vintage in it, and the stain reads the verdict.
proposals.new: Genesis dressed Judah in garments washed in the blood of grapes; the Treader wears the same wardrobe with the other vintage in it, and the stain reads the verdict.
proposals.rationale: Clear typographical error; the intended phrase is 'same wardrobe'.

proposals.old: Wash in Sent and come seeing; refuse Sent and die under its stones.
proposals.new: Washing in Sent brings seeing; refusing Sent brings death under its stones.
proposals.summary: Converts parallel imperatives into direct assertion.
proposals.rationale: Commands to the reader violate house style against director cues; the parallel outcomes stand without the cue.

proposals.old: Solomon set the first beside the Name-tower itself, one verse later:
proposals.new: Solomon set the first of them beside the Name-tower itself, one verse later:
proposals.summary: Make the referent of 'the first' explicit.
proposals.rationale: The structures were just named in the prior sentence; 'of them' restores the link without lengthening the line or altering the claim.

proposals.old: and the plumbline hung against their wall read the verdict the storm executed.
proposals.new: and the plumbline that hung against their wall read the verdict the storm executed.
proposals.summary: Mark the reduced relative clause with 'that'.
proposals.rationale: The bare sequence 'hung ... read' can parse as two finite verbs missing a conjunction; 'that' locks the intended participial reading while preserving the personification.
